item.title: REF 0.7.0
item.description:
• Clipping is now a note, not something to fix: loud masters clip, often on purpose. To have it flagged again: Settings › Comparing › Clipped samples.
  • The zoomed waveform is bigger and plainer, like DJ software: taller lanes, no red or white marks and no dB lines over it, and the lane's top and bottom edges are 0 dB. Any of them can come back in Settings › Meters › Zoomed waveform.
